notes.title: Major Expansion VR Update! – New Maps, Faster Battles, Customization, and More!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Commanders![/b]

We’ve just rolled out a major Expansion VR update designed to make your battles faster, more strategic, and more personal than ever before.
[b]Here’s what’s new:[/b]
[b]• Faster Gameplay:[/b]
 Units move quicker, and energy recharges faster — matches now flow with intense, tactical momentum.
[b]• AI Difficulty Options:[/b]
 Choose from Casual, Extreme, or Impossible when battling the AI. Play your way — relaxed or ruthless.
[b]• 5 Brand-New Maps:[/b]
 Discover fresh layouts, visuals, and asymmetrical design that challenge your strategies in new ways.
[b]• Custom Emblems & Unit Colors:[/b]
 Select a personal emblem and customize your unit colors to show your identity on the battlefield.
[b]• Performance & Bug Fixes:[/b]
 Enjoy smoother gameplay and improved stability across the board.
Now’s the perfect time to return to Expansion VR — or dive in for the first time.
See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Space Patrick’s Day
notes.content:
Greetings, Commander!
The galaxy is turning green as we celebrate Space Patrick’s Day in Expansion VR! We’re excited to bring you Update v0.20, packed with seasonal decorations and gameplay enhancements.
What’s New in v0.20:
[list]
[*] [b]Festive Decorations[/b] – Your battles and environments now feature Space Patrick’s Day-inspired elements, bringing a touch of luck and celebration.
[*] [b]Smarter AI Opponents[/b] – In single-player mode, enemy AI has been improved and will now scale in difficulty after multiple victories, keeping you on your toes!
[*] [b]Bug Fixes and Performance Enhancements[/b] – We’ve fine-tuned stability and resolved several issues to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.
[/list]
Don’t miss out on the festivities! Jump into the game, test your luck, and share your experiences with the community.
See you on the battlefield, Commanders! 🍀

notes.title: Valentine update v0.19
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Commander![/b]
Love is in the air across the Galaxy!
We’re excited to unveil a special update for Expansion VR, our beloved virtual reality strategy game, just in time for Valentine’s Day!
Prepare for an enchanting experience with this update, featuring:
[list]
[*] Charming Valentine-themed decorations for your spaceship, setting the perfect romantic ambiance.
[*] Festive Valentine-inspired accessories for enemy avatars on the battlefield, adding a playful twist to your tactical encounters.
[*] Previously missed events now display their past decorations.
[/list]
Join us in Expansion VR during the event period to immerse yourself in a unique blend of Real-Time Strategy and Valentine’s celebration. Don’t miss this chance to spread love and strategy across the stars!

notes.title: Update notes for 28 November 2024
notes.content:
[b]Hello, commanders![/b]

The latest update for [b]Expansion VR[/b] is now available.

[b]Avatars added[/b]
You can now see your opponent, and they can see you! Wave to greet, celebrate victory, or take advantage of a moment to deploy a unit while they’re distracted.

The first avatar is inspired by Mainers' Jackhammer, with more options coming soon. Players will unlock new avatars as they progress through the game.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor game balance adjustments
[*] Enhanced unit and AI behavior
[/list]
[b]Visual Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Upgraded outer space visuals
[*] Fixed projectile visual effects
[*] Optimized lighting
[*] Resolved animation issues
[*] Eliminated shimmering caused by aliasing
[/list]
[b]QOL Features & Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Faster loading times
[*] Improvements to the game lobby
[*] Enhanced matchmaking
[*] Fixed visual bugs (e.g., textures in the post-battle menu)
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Diary
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders! 

We started this Developer Diary to keep you updated  with Expansion development. We will be posting about upcoming updates and future plans. 

Since the Early Access release we have worked on bringing in more content as well as implementing some QOL features. While it is still early to discuss the upcoming big updates in detail we can hint on some of the planned features.

[list]
[*] Avatars. Wave hands to greet your opponent and show off your new appearance with a choice of customizable avatars to pick from. 
[*] Co-op. It is fun to play vs your friends but also fun to play together vs AI. 
[*] Hand tracking interaction. We are going to implement additional ways to interact with units and the environment - directly with your hands!
[*] Single player campaign. Sometimes we want to play along. There will be a story driven campaign with special missions, progression and, of course, rewards!
[/list]

More details will be available later and now we announce a small update scheduled for upcoming weeks to implement the avatar system. Good news! The  avatars work smoothly across all platforms.

The galaxy awaits, commanders!

Yours,
Plazma Studio

notes.title: Early Access is Live!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Welcome to the world of Expansion, commanders[/h1][/b]

We’re excited to announce that Expansion VR is AVAILABLE NOW in Steam Early Access!

Starting today, you can purchase Expansion VR on Steam and join our Early Access journey. What’s more, we’re running a special 10% launch discount from now through March 31, 2024.

This is a landmark moment for us on our journey to build the best strategy game for virtual reality. We are honored to welcome you on this journey with us. The galaxy awaits!

[b][h2]What is Expansion VR[/h2][/b]

Expansion is a VR auto battler RTS with deck-building elements that fuses strategic depth, immersive gameplay, and an original sci-fi universe. 

Three factions are locked in a desperate struggle for resources in newly colonized celestial realms. As a space warlord, you orchestrate your forces from a godlike vantage point, assembling battle squads, securing resources and outsmarting your opponents across both a single-player PVE mode and intense PVP multiplayer battles. 

Step into the roles of daring Privateers, ingenious Miners, or ferocious Pigdogs as they struggle for dominance on the outskirts of the known universe!

[b][h2]What’s featured in Early Access[/h2][/b]

Expansion VR already features all of its core mechanics, as well as several dozen units, several maps, and three different factions. We estimate at least 10 hours of gameplay to unlock all units and explore all aspects of this version of the game. 

We've also established a system for purchasing and unlocking units, player progression, PvP and PvE modes, leaderboards, and a tutorial.

[h2][b]How you can join the development[/b][/h2]

We have a lot of ideas… But we want to work on things that MATTER TO YOU the most.

Our goal is to build Expansion VR together with our community. We want to make the game the best it can be for all strategy lovers and VR enthusiasts. So we want to hear from YOU.

We already launched a Discord server where you can provide feedback, suggest & discuss ideas, and share your thoughts on development. You’re invited!

Join our Discord: [url=discord.gg/27Wk7tcGez]discord.gg/27Wk7tcGez[/url]

We are also considering the option of creating developer vlogs and development diaries to keep the community informed about our progress. You can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/expansion_vr]Twitter/X[/url] and [url=http://youtube.com/@plazma_std]YouTube[/url] to keep up with these updates.

The galaxy awaits, commanders!

Yours,
Plazma Studio
